synthesis.description: As staff move to the new employer, HR and infrastructure teams send notices about orientation sessions split by alphabetical order, benefits presentations, new hire paperwork due by 3:00 PM on a stated day, missing application details, outstanding pre-employment drug tests, access card pickup and email file migration with compliance forms. Staff complete the paperwork, tests and migration steps; a planned system migration was postponed.
steps: HR announces orientation sessions and benefits presentations.
HR sets a deadline for new hire paperwork and flags incomplete applications.
HR reminds individuals of outstanding pre-employment drug tests.
Staff collect access cards and export their email per migration instructions.
Teams batch file migration compliance forms and send them in.
Infrastructure migrates users to the new environment or announces a delay.
synthesis.approach: Track each transferring employee against one onboarding checklist (orientation, paperwork, application, drug test, access card, email migration, compliance form) and send reminders automatically from the outstanding items.
synthesis.rationale: The notices repeat the same handful of requirements to many people, and the reminders show items being chased one by one; a shared checklist makes status visible and drives the reminders.
